name: io.github.affset/mcp
title: affset
description: Run affset from chat: stats, campaigns, zones, payouts, targeting, and team.

environmentVariables.name: AFFSET_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin of your affset ad server API (no path, query, or embedded credentials).

environmentVariables.name: AFFSET_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tenant API key (Bearer token). Its namespace must match AFFSET_NAMESPACE.

environmentVariables.name: AFFSET_NAMESPACE
environmentVariables.description: Tenant namespace this key belongs to (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens; 3–63 chars).

environmentVariables.name: AFFSET_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-request HTTP timeout in milliseconds (1000–300000).

environmentVariables.name: AFFSET_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to true to register only read-only tools (no create/update/delete/cut).
